gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-mono: Nordic strokes never vary in thickness, spaced out like brush dabs with tight, folded openings. Then Noto Sans Mono loosens everything up, giving each letter generous room and wide curves that feel sturdy on the page.

gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Rough-hewn and ancient, Nordic keeps its curves thick even at the turns. Noto Sans Nabataean, a sans-serif, stands nearly cap-height in its lowercase with open s curves, and a modest body size lets that shine against a larger heading.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-nandinaga: Powerful from the first glance, Nordic holds a single stroke weight with zero modulation, its spacing scattered like brush dabs. Noto Sans Nandinagari, a sans-serif, softens it with generous openings.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-newa: Powerful and ancient, Nordic folds its letters shut like pressed leaves. Noto Sans Newa, a sans-serif, counters with a clearly open e and generous bowls, so the page moves from cramped heading to breathing text.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Ancient and weighty, Nordic draws every stroke identically, vertical and horizontal alike. Noto Sans Nushu, a sans, holds its terminals far from the stroke body under a towering x-height, which leaves the heading to work alone at larger sizes.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Nordic keeps its letters closed and its strokes constant, spaced like brush dabs across paper. Noto Sans Ogham, a sans, opens wide gaps in the e.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-old-itali: Powerful and a bit stern, Nordic holds one stroke weight with no thick-thin shifts and its openings tightly closed. But Noto Sans Old Italic, a sans, keeps curve endings well apart and its x-height nearly touching the capitals.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-old-north: Noto Sans Old North Arabian forms a dense band of lowercase, with terminals flaring outward like tongs. Nordic closes its letters and spaces them like brush dabs, while Noto Sans Old North Arabian, a plain sans, stays open and approachable.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdi: Crisp and approachable, Noto Sans Old Sogdian lifts its x-height almost to cap height. Wide-mouthed letters stay sharp even when small, so paragraphs of this sans-serif run smoothly beneath Nordic's closed, ancient heading.
